data.title: Kanojo Face The Animation
data.title_japanese: 彼女フェイス THE ANIMATION
data.synopsis: Konishi, a high school student, and his girlfriend Sanae regularly attend drama club. The boy has long fallen for the beauty for her sincerity, hard work, and other feminine advantages, and they began dating. Weeks and months passed, and the relationship did not move a step. One day, while doing another rehearsal for a drama club, Sanae finds condoms in the guy's room. Konishi thought there might be trouble. However, the girl's face was already frozen in anticipation.

data.title: Ajin ga Osuki nan desu ne
data.title_japanese: 亜人がお好きなんですね
data.synopsis:
In the near future, humans and animals live in harmony. The result is the emergence of half-humans who live like normal people, but with their own characteristics.

Episode 1: The decent and clean goat Maya periodically shaves her fur on the lower part of her body, which she is very embarrassed about, because many people would dislike it. One day, right while shaving, her owner Christophe catches her. The girl has already managed to get upset, but in vain. What is natural is wonderful. And the young lord was eager to help her.

Episode 2: Little Meguru unexpectedly met a big dog Mokka in an alley and got scared and wet himself. The dog calmed the boy down and invited him over to dry his clothes and take a shower. But as soon as the husky took off her clothes to help him in the bath, the boy could no longer think about anything but her.

data.title: Kairyuu to Yuubinyasan
data.title_japanese: カイリューとゆうびんやさん
data.synopsis:
Hana, a young girl from the Paldea region who admires the postman Dragonite and aspires to become an ace mail carrier, one day receives a letter with no address. Determined to find the sender, she embarks on a frantic search alongside her partner, Hogator. After running around town, she finally tracks down the sender—a boy named Rio. Upon hearing his story, Hana learns that Rio wrote the letter to celebrate his father's birthday, who is stationed alone in the Kanto region. However, the day of his father's birthday has already arrived...

(Source: Official YouTube, translated)

data.title_japanese: 武动乾坤 第五季
data.synopsis:
The young Lin Dong embarks on a journey to search for the whereabouts of the Devouring Ancestor Talisman, venturing deep into the ancient ruins of the Great Wilderness. He continuously devotes himself to cultivation, and finally, the clan competition arrives... Facing his opponent, Lin Langtian, a genius of the Lin family who had crippled his father and ruthlessly harmed him, Lin Dong's heart is filled with unresolved humiliation, and he is eager for revenge and to turn the tables!

(Source: WeTV)

titles.title: イクイク サキュバス再教育

data.title: Ikuiku Succubus Saikyouiku
data.title_japanese: イクイク サキュバス再教育
data.synopsis: Being an experienced teacher, Busujima fills students' heads with high-quality knowledge. One day, exchange students from the succubus kingdom come to study with him. These insidious and ugly creatures completely refuse to learn, and the quiet life of a man is turned upside down. But he wouldn't be called Busujima for nothing. Raised according to samurai traditions, he intends to walk his path to the very end and fulfill his teaching duty – to drum into the disobedient succubi the desire to learn, one way or another.
